notificationDescription: Manage notification preferences and configure which notifications you receive

descriptions.price_alert: Get notified when stock prices reach your target levels
descriptions.trade_executed: Get notified when your buy/sell orders are executed
descriptions.report_completed: Get notified when investment reports are ready
descriptions.analysis_completed: Get notified when market analysis is complete
descriptions.data_refreshed: Get notified when market data has been updated
descriptions.system_announcement: Get notified about important system updates and announcements
